verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a remote-access tool, but the evidence documents no scheduler or recurring-workflow feature. The CLI and REST API are scriptable building blocks for one-off actions such as install, configure, connect, remove, and data retrieval. Any recurrence would depend on external deployment tools or user-side scripting, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data from the [my.anydesk I](http://my.anydesk.com/login) management console.
